## Review

Paste the written review here, or link the comment that holds it: what was looked at,
what was run, what was found.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run verify-generator` passes
- [ ] If this touches the admin panel, the [browser tests](https://github.com/DrNoisys-Softworks/gm-scriptorium/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPING.md#running-the-browser-tests) ran with no Playwright or axe-core skips
- [ ] No real names or campaign content (see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/DrNoisys-Softworks/gm-scriptorium/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No edits to the vendored generator (`vendor/gm-apprentice-publish/`, `node_modules/gm-apprentice-publish/`)
